mentioned.quote: xAI treats AI-accelerated malicious cyber offense as a core risk domain.

threshold.note: No specific capability or quantitative level for this risk. 'significance and severity thresholds' (p.3), 'risk tiers' (p.6) and 'whether the threshold has been reached' (p.6) are generic and never defined.

response.quote: xAI will only proceed with the development, the making available on the market, and/or the use of the model, if the systemic risks stemming from the model are determined to be acceptable.
response.note: No risk-specific threshold, so this is the framework-wide gate (rule C3, no-threshold case). 'acceptable' is undefined. Judgement call.

acc_decider.note: No named role or body. Section 4 Governance (p.9) and 'risk owners' (p.8) name none; 'legal and compliance reviews' are unnamed.

acc_external.note: No binding external review. 'human expert red-teaming' (p.6) not stated as external; SOC 2 Type II (p.8) concerns information security, not this risk's safeguards or adherence; third-party feedback (p.8) is a channel, not a review.
